teamFlows.description: Validates specific team-location and team-court lockdowns.
rules: clear all rules. Panthers Crossroads: No play before 11AM, max 6 games, must play ONLY at ahmedabad. Panthers Frontier: Prefer to play at NEW. Panthers Tri-State: Can play at any location.

teamFlows.description: Checks complex inter-team dependencies and simultaneous play blocks.
rules: clear all rules. Panthers Crossroads and Panthers Vanguard cannot play at the same time. Panthers Tri-State cannot play when Panthers Frontier is playing. Court 1 at ahmedabad must remain empty on all days.

teamFlows.description: Verifies specific school and house rules including the 5:30 PM edge case.
rules: ahmedabad: No games before 11AM, after 4PM, or during 12-1PM and 3-4PM. At NEW: No games before 11AM, after 4PM, or during 12-2PM and 5-5:30PM.

teamFlows.description: Checks first/last game rules and back-to-back restrictions.
rules: clear all rules. Opening at ahmedabad: Panthers Crossroads vs Panthers Vanguard. Panthers Tri-State: Must have a 1-hour rest period between games. Panthers Frontier at Pool 10: Must alternate courts every game; specifically, if on Court 1, next is Court 2.

teamFlows.description: Validates specific team-location-court-time constraints for Panthers teams at ahmedabad and NEW locations.

Panthers Tri-State: Only at ahmedabad on Court 2 before 4PM, or at NEW on Court 2 after 4PM. Panthers Vanguard: Only at ahmedabad on Court 1 and must finish before 12PM.
